name: Security report warning
about: Do not file vulnerabilities publicly; read SECURITY.md
title: "DO NOT SUBMIT A PUBLIC VULNERABILITY REPORT"
labels: security
assignees: ""
---

Do not submit this issue if it contains vulnerability details, exploit steps,
secrets, personal data, or customer content.

Read `SECURITY.md` and use its verified private route when one is available.
GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting is intended but is not yet verified as
enabled for this repository. If no private route is available, retain the
report rather than publishing sensitive details.

This public template is only a warning and is not a reporting channel.
